subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Letter-sound relationships of some single letters; names some letters of the alphabet

show.line: Two more sounds! m, m, mat. d, d, dog. Can you hear them?

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with d, as in dog?
Tap the letter that says m.
Say the sound with me. d, as in dog!
Which one starts with m, as in mat?
Trace d with your finger. Round first, then a tall line up and down.
Trace m with your finger. Down, then up and over, up and over.
Does it start with m or d? Sort the pictures.

hints: Listen for the first sound. m hums. d taps.
m has two humps. d has a round tummy and a tall back.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the letter that says d.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one with two humps says d!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two humps is m. d has a tall back.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Round tummy, tall back. That is d!

parent_line: Can hear and write the sounds m and d.
